review.official:
U-Official, commonly known as Streamer U, used to be an online streamer in a certain
nomadic city
. After being recommended by Operator
Click
, she signed a cooperation agreement with
Rhodes Island
. In addition to providing broadcasting services for our operators, she is responsible for hosting events and other work. She also serves as a consultant and provides support when Rhodes Island interfaces with media organizations.
Other than Click, who once lent her a helping hand, Streamer U has also had encounters with a few other Rhodes Island operators, though not always under pleasant circumstances and while going by a different name. Ultimately, we suspended any further background checks at her insistence.
Eureka?
––
Tequila
, upon passing by coincidentally
You've got the wrong person, you big fat liar!
––Streamer U, babbling incoherently

files.description:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator U-Official shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.12u/L
This operator doesn't even want to go outside.
While remaining cooped up indoors undeniably reduces the risk of Oripathy, sitting around all day definitely isn't healthy either. I wish she'd exercise more, and if that's too tough, I can at least help with some basic stretching.
––Gavial

Fantastic! I look forward to working with you, Dr. Gavial!
––Streamer U, newly arrived and hard at work building relationships

Alright! Gavial, you're in charge of helping her make her debut at Rhodes Island! Oh, but since she's a newbie, go easy on her, okay?
––Closure, who agreed to go along with Streamer U's idea for a premiere broadcast

[Livestream Record 1]
Welcome to our special program: 'A Date With U-chan: Exclusive Interviews with Rhodes Island's Hottest Hotties'! This is everyone's favorite Streamer U, and today, I'll be introducing our guest–
Huh? Phantom vanished without a trace, Leonhardt's out on duty, and even Qanipalaat is busy? So you could only manage to get this... uhh... sunny and aggressively outgoing guy... to come to the rescue? Okay then...
Our guest today is none other than the hottest of them all, the most passionate operator at Rhodes Island: THRM-EX!
......
You say that your 'thermal shock is undefeatable,' but is that really true? Not sure I buy that.
Huh? What's that countdown for?
Some kind of special surprise? I can't wait to find out!

[Livestream Record 2]
Eight hour marathon stream challenge! As long as I don't disrupt the lives or work of any other operators, there are no breaks on this train! If yours truly manages to accomplish this feat, you'd better shower me with donos! And if I don't make it... I'll have to suffer through Round 2 of Dr. Gavial's stretching challenge tomorrow!
Hello there, what's your name?
This is the first we've met. Thanks for being a fan of the stream!
......
You'd be better believe it. Getting good footage is an absolute must...
Beeping? I don't see anything wrong on my end... Might be something with your equipment?
Huh? What's wrong? Why'd you stop talking all of a sudden? Did I say something wrong?
......
............
..................
Please, say something, Scene! Anything!

[Livestream Record 3]
Welcome to Streamer U's first mukbang since coming aboard Rhodes Island! Today's special guest is... Tada! Yan's shining star, FEater!
......
C'mon, it'll be fine! I've heard all about Shangshu's delicacies, but I can handle a little spice! Now, let's have a taste...
(Violent coughing sounds)
N-No, I don't need water! I said I'm doing a mukbang, so I have to finish the goal I set for myself!
......
I'm fine... Streaming is my job... I need to maintain... a professional attitude... See, there's only one piece of meat left on the platter... It'd be a shame to let it go to waste...
Have I ever considered doing an event organizer gig in Shangshu? Hehe. C'mon, when have I ever turned down a business offer? But, lemme finish my food first...

Footnote: Due to excessive sweating, Streamer U collapsed from dehydration after eating the last piece of meat and was rushed to Medical. Thankfully, she did not incur any serious injuries.
Addendum: FEater was moved by Streamer U's professionalism and dedication to her craft, and is currently contacting her acquaintances in the Shangshu art and literature circles to try to expand the streamer's career options.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Can I go live in here? I'm not really comfortable having a whole crowd standing around watching me stream, so I'd feel way more at ease in your office... Besides, I'm your assistant now anyway, heehee.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, I got to thinking that the stream incident might not have been a totally bad thing. After all, I got to know so many nice people ready to lend a helping hand, and you too... Shoot! I forgot to turn off my mic–– Yes, and all of you as well! With your support, I'll break out of this funk!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I need to decompress after that stream... Games? Doctor, were you even watching my stream? Chat wouldn't stop making fun of how much I suck. I don't wanna play another game this whole week... And that's why I need to practice every day? Uhh... I guess you have a point there?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Awwgh, it's so frustrating! How come a clip of me tripping over my words gets so many more views than all my VODs combined? I really don't understand viewers these days... Look, Doctor, what's so funny about this compilation of my brain-far—you just laughed, right? You totally laughed just now!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I won an award the first time I did a solo show. Pretty lucky, huh? What, don't believe me? Look right here, 'Awarded to the employee who stayed put until the end of the show during an earthquake'! Getting hit by an earthquake hit during your debut sounds unlucky? Ah-Ahaha...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I used to work my butt off every day so I could make more money, then shop more and shop better. But you know, when I use fancy concealer to hide my eye bags, I sometimes wanna cry... Oh, uh, s-speaking of crying, getting fired from the TV station made me want to cry a lot more.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: When I get up there to face my audience, the only advantage I have is the angle of my camera. But you, Doctor... You're the only one who watches my stream in person. You're my most special, and most unique audience. Ahem, it would be even nicer if you tossed a little dono my way~

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hello. You looking for the Doctor? What? No, no bother at all. The Doctor's fast asleep, and I'm just eating some dry instant noodles. Want a chunk?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello everyone, this is your omnipotent streamer, Eure—Errrr, sorry, scratch that. Rhodes Island operator, U-official! Reporting in, Doctor!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Doctor, I'm not gonna sugarcoat it. No matter how many vids like this I watch, I won't learn how to fight.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Go to war? Me?! This has to be a dream…

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: And you're giving me command of the squad to boot? This dream sure is funny, haha...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Well, since this is a dream anyway, I will mop up all the enemies for you!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Bow down before the true master! Wooooo-wata! Scared now?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Heehee, mind sending me the instructions... in a superchat?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Your streamer is in perfect condition and ready to go live!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Deep breaths... stay calm…

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Just treat it like a regular stream? I'll try!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Ah, ah, mic check! Can everyone hear me?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Let me know what you think in chat!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Next up, time to read the comments!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Dear viewer, for your aggressive behavior, you've been permabaned from the channel! Oh no!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: The battle's over, so why haven't I woken up from my dream yet... What? This isn't a dream? Then, how come I'm not hurt at all?!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Phew, it's finally over... Time to get a good night's sleep. I hope I don't have any more weird dreams about war.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Hey you guys running off there, don't forget to tell your friends and family about me. Thank you!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Waahhh… this is the worst ending to a stream I could've imagined…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Can I use this place as the backdrop for my next stream? No? Fine, I'll try someplace else then.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Don't jumpscare me like that! A monster just pushed me into the pit, now I have to do a 'no death run'…

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I'm done streaming, Doctor. Wanna take a walk around the deck?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: New Year's Special: Exploring flavor across the lands! Instant noodles inspired by the delicacies of each country! First up is this pack of Kjerag red-braised–– Hey, why's my viewer count dropping?! Don't leave, guys! I was just kidding!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Thanks for letting me stream from your office, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday to you! That's it everyone, I hope all of my friends out there celebrating birthdays today have a gorgeous day! I'm gonna end stream slightly earlier this time, so see you guys tomorrow!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Back in Dossoles, the TV station would throw a year end party, but I never knew these could be so chill until I came to Rhodes Island... Huh? Are you talking to me? You want me to sing? Sure, but just for the record– my musical tastes are pretty old-fashioned.
